findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext within the Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the Terraform state, source code, or Lambda console/API. This is a critical credential leak (CWE-798).

The Lambda function does not configure a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables at rest, relying only on the default AWS-managed key, which weakens protection of the embedded secrets (CWE-311).
The function uses nodejs12.x, which is an end-of-life runtime no longer receiving security updates, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities (CWE-1104).
